section.37: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

37.name_native: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Anas that :'Ali came to some people of Az-Zutt, who worshipped idols, and burned them. Ibn 'Abbas said: "But the Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: 'Whoever changes his religion, kill him
